lines.text: A town without a place on any chart. Its lamps are lit. Someone expected you.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: The Council recorded every stolen cargo. The missing column was people.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: An empty chair is still a chair. Sit carefully. Decide what this light is for.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: There goes the road. The sea has remembered where it left this town.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: Rope, oil, names. Keep what you can carry. Decide who you can bring.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: A lighthouse promises a destination. Before you turn the lens, choose who should find it.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: No more rehearsals. Ring it. Let the Harbor hear what you decided.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: The shore will ask what happened here. You may find yourselves giving different answers.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: That is where your account ends. The sea, of course, keeps its own.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: A relief ship. Food. Medicine. Passengers. The wreck was deliberate.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: A survivor wrote between the cargo lines. Small handwriting can carry a great accusation.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: The lantern takes the oil. The patrol takes an interest.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: An extra knot. Two more places. Sometimes hope is this practical.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: For a moment, even the bell has nothing to add.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: The rope tightens. Someone on the other end remembers being alive.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: Give a stolen name its place again, and listen to what changes.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: The lens is cracked. Its invitation is perfectly clear.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: One blank line. One open passage. Absence can be a kind of mercy.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: The pages survived. Your breath may not last as long.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: Salt draws a boundary the water understands.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: An offer can sound like rescue. Read it twice.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: You keep your own name. The Harbor does not thank you for it.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: A voice from beneath the water. Still yours. Still useful.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: Not every name in the ledger has to stay there.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: The tide has taken your breath. It has not taken your turn.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.

lines.text: The Harbor changes its attention. It has learned which streets you favor.
lines.speaker: The Underteller
lines.delivery: Quiet, dry warmth; spare coastal storyteller. No imitation of a real performer.
